title: Phys4D: Fine-Grained Physics-Consistent 4D Modeling from Video Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2603.03485v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent video diffusion models have achieved impressive capabilities as large-scale generative world models. However, these models often struggle with fine-grained physical consistency, exhibiting physically implausible dynamics over time. In this work, we present \textbf{Phys4D}, a pipeline for learning physics-consistent 4D world representations from video diffusion models. Phys4D adopts \textbf{a three-stage training paradigm} that progressively lifts appearance-driven video diffusion models into physics-consistent 4D world representations. translated_title: Phys4D：基于视频扩散的细粒度物理一致性4D建模
translated_abstract: 近期的视频扩散模型作为大规模生成式世界模型已展现出令人印象深刻的能力。然而，这些模型往往难以实现细粒度的物理一致性，随时间推移会表现出物理上不合理的动态。在本工作中，我们提出了Phys4D，一个从视频扩散模型中学习物理一致性4D世界表示的流水线。Phys4D采用三阶段训练范式，逐步将外观驱动的视频扩散模型提升为物理一致的4D世界表示。我们首先通过大规模伪监督预训练引导出鲁棒的几何与运动表示，为4D场景建模奠定基础；随后使用仿真生成的数据进行基于物理的监督微调，强制实现时间上一致的4D动态；最后应用基于仿真的强化学习来纠正残留的物理违例。
tldr: Phys4D提出三阶段训练范式，通过大规模伪监督预训练、基于物理的监督微调和基于仿真的强化学习，将外观驱动的视频扩散模型逐步提升为物理一致的4D世界表示。
en_tdlr: Phys4D introduces a three-stage training paradigm that progressively lifts appearance-driven video diffusion models into physics-consistent 4D world representations through pseudo-supervised pretraining, physics-grounded supervised fine-tuning, and simulation-grounded reinforcement learning.
